summary.goal: Add SQLite tables for ideation outcomes, plan quality signals, and ideation baselines. Extend config_versions with ideation_config column.

acceptance_criteria.description: ideation_outcomes table with UNIQUE(session_id, send_number), indexes on session_id and timestamp
plan_quality_signals table with UNIQUE(plan_id), index on session_id
ideation_baselines table with PRIMARY KEY(pattern)
config_versions table extended with nullable ideation_config TEXT column

TunerStorage interface extended with: insertIdeationOutcome, getIdeationOutcomesBySession, getRecentIdeationOutcomes, insertPlanQualitySignal, getPlanQualitySignal, getPlanQualitySignalBySession, getIdeationBaseline, upsertIdeationBaseline, listIdeationBaselines
JSON columns (specialists_spawned, specialist_contributions, specialist_contribution_rates) use JSON.stringify/parse
Schema migration is idempotent (safe to re-run)

steps.title: Add ideation tables to schema
steps.description: Extend packages/tuner/src/storage/schema.ts with CREATE TABLE statements for ideation_outcomes, plan_quality_signals, ideation_baselines. Add indexes.

acceptance_criteria.description: ideation_outcomes table with UNIQUE(session_id, send_number), idx on session_id and timestamp
plan_quality_signals table with UNIQUE(plan_id), idx on session_id
ideation_baselines table with PRIMARY KEY(pattern)
JSON columns: specialists_spawned TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', specialist_contributions TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
Boolean is_first_send stored as INTEGER (0/1)

architecture.pattern: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS with indexes

model.ideation_outcomes: session_id, plan_id, session_duration_seconds, conversation_turns, specialists_spawned (JSON), specialist_contributions (JSON), blocks_total, blocks_curated, blocks_user_edited, avg_block_confidence, is_first_send (INT), send_number, understanding_field_count, source, timestamp
model.plan_quality_signals: plan_id, session_id, questions_asked, questions_hard_blocking, versions_before_approval, improvements_suggested, improvements_accepted, blocks_received, blocks_mapped_to_steps, time_to_approval_seconds, source, timestamp
model.ideation_baselines: pattern (PK), mean_questions_per_plan, stddev_questions, mean_versions_before_approval, stddev_versions, mean_block_utilization, stddev_block_utilization, mean_conversation_turns, stddev_conversation_turns, specialist_contribution_rates (JSON), m2_* fields, sample_count, last_updated

steps.title: Extend config_versions table
steps.description: Add migration to extend config_versions with ideation_config TEXT column. Check if column exists first for idempotency.

acceptance_criteria.description: Migration adds ideation_config TEXT column if not exists
Migration is idempotent (safe to re-run)

architecture.pattern: ALTER TABLE IF NOT EXISTS logic or PRAGMA table_info check

acceptance_criteria.description: insertIdeationOutcome(outcome: IdeationOutcome): void
getIdeationOutcomesBySession(sessionId: string): IdeationOutcome[]
getRecentIdeationOutcomes(limit: number): IdeationOutcome[]
insertPlanQualitySignal(signal: PlanQualitySignal): void
getPlanQualitySignal(planId: string): PlanQualitySignal | null
getPlanQualitySignalBySession(sessionId: string): PlanQualitySignal[]
getIdeationBaseline(pattern: string): IdeationBaseline | null
upsertIdeationBaseline(baseline: IdeationBaseline): void
listIdeationBaselines(): IdeationBaseline[]

steps.title: Implement SQLite storage methods
steps.description: Implement all new interface methods in packages/tuner/src/storage/sqlite.ts using prepared statements. Handle JSON serialization for array/object columns.

acceptance_criteria.description: All methods use prepared statements via better-sqlite3
JSON columns use JSON.stringify on write, JSON.parse on read
Boolean is_first_send converted to/from 0/1
upsertIdeationBaseline uses INSERT OR REPLACE
Methods follow existing pattern (e.g., insertTaskOutcome, getTaskBaseline)
